Metadata.Goal: Support dotted FQN tag names (`<dg.materials.CrudTable>`) in xnl-core parser with roundtrip fidelity and zero regression on path/mutation/loader tooling.
Metadata.Description: Downstream dg-cell-mvi lowcode v3 unit DSL uses definition FQNs as element-tree tags. Only gap found by capability verification: parseNode tag reading rejects '.'. Additive grammar change; tag stays a joined string.

TaskSpace.name: extend-xnl-core-dsl-syntax
TaskSpace.Description: Phases: grammar/behavior delta, parser implementation, regression tests.

TaskGroup.name: Grammar and behavior delta
TaskGroup.Description: Author xnl-dotted-tag behavior delta; freeze segment grammar and error boundaries.

TaskGroup.name: Parser implementation
TaskGroup.Description: Extend parseNode tag reading to dotted segments; tag remains joined string; invalid dot forms raise parse errors.

Task.name: Implement dotted tag reading in parseNode
Task.Description: packages/core/src/parser.ts: read tag as seg(.seg)*, each segment via existing identifier grammar; join with '.'; error on empty/leading/trailing segment.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Dotted tags parse; invalid dot forms raise UNEXPECTED_TOKEN-class errors

Task.name: Verify formatter roundtrip (expected zero change)
Task.Description: Confirm formatter/lineBlockFormatter print dotted tags verbatim; parse->stringify->parse stable.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Roundtrip stable for dotted-tag documents in both formatters

TaskGroup.name: Tests and regression
TaskGroup.Description: Dotted-tag test suite + full-suite regression + typecheck.

Task.name: Add dotted-tag tests
Task.Description: Grammar cases (valid/invalid), full section combination (#id+metadata+{}+()+[]), roundtrip both formatters, mutation diff/apply on dotted-tag node, path resolve/set through dotted-tag node.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: All delta suites covered by tests

Task.name: Run package tests and typecheck
Task.Description: xnl-core full test suite green; tsc --noEmit clean; existing tests unchanged.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Full suite passes; no existing test modified to accommodate the change
